sloka: य एष निशितैः शूलैः सुतीक्ष्णैः प्रासतोमरैः।अर्चिष्मद्भिर्वृतो भाति भूतैरिव महेश्वरः ।। ६.७१.१३ ।।
transliteration: ya eṣa niśitaiḥ śūlaiḥ sutīkṣṇaiḥ prāsatomaraiḥ।arciṣmadbhirvṛto bhāti bhūtairiva maheśvaraḥ ।। 6.71.13 ।।

translations.english: "Who is he in the midst, with sharp tridents and shining spears, like Maheswara surrounded by beings?"
